name: Deel
summary: Global hiring, payroll and EOR platform — pay contractors and employees compliantly in 150+ countries, priced per contractor or employee, with HR tools and US PEO options.
best_for: companies hiring internationally without local entities — contractors paid compliantly in 150+ countries, or full EOR employment where you need someone on the ground fast
skip_if: your team is all-domestic (a local payroll tool is far cheaper), or you hire enough people in one country that opening your own entity beats paying per-employee EOR fees forever
honest_knock: Every price is a ‘starting at’ and every button says ‘book a demo’ — the real bill depends on countries, benefits and add-ons, and only firms up in a sales conversation. And know what EOR money buys: at $599+/month per employee you’re paying for compliance risk transfer, not software — worth it in unfamiliar jurisdictions, expensive where you could open your own entity.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month per worker for Find talent (hiring)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-09; the figures are unchanged since 2026-08-17) Pricing is per worker and demo-led, and each product is priced separately. Find talent (sourcing, screening and onboarding candidates) is $14 per worker a month. Contractor management is $49 per contractor a month, or $325 per month per Contractor of Record if you want Deel to carry the compliance risk. US PEO starts at $125 per employee a month. And EOR, where Deel employs your international hire, starts at $599 per employee a month. The pricing FAQ says pricing is month to month with no long-term commitment, and Deel's Contractor of Record page adds that each Contractor of Record contract requires a deposit of one month of the contractor's payment. There is a free demo and final quotes come through sales. The spread is the point: the same headcount costs $14 or $599 a month depending on which relationship you need, so identify the employment model before comparing vendors.
